newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were mostly stable in late trading on Friday, with demand staying weak amid falls in Malaysia, traders said.

They said palm olein was quoted at 1,370-75 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening, but trades were also heard at 1,365-70 rupiah. Crude palm oil was last done at 1,175 rupiah/kg at a tender in the North Sumatran city of Medan.
"Prices are generally holding, but there are players selling at below the market range," one trader said. "Decreases in Malaysia dampened sentiment and kept buyers sidelined."
The traders said prices were expected to trend steady to lower next week following the declines in Malaysia.
"But I don't think prices will go down much," one trader said. "Margins are already quite tight."
Data from Belawan Port showed that the MT Istana-VI will leave the North Sumatran port on Saturday for Tanjung Priok in Jakarta with 4,500 tonnes of palm olein.
Data from Belawan Port showed that the K.M. Pertiwi will leave the North Sumatran port on Friday for Kuala Enok with 1,000 tonnes of coconut oil.
